title: Adaptive weighted drain controller for regional hosted API rollouts
creator: Ava Ramirez
description: Goal: implement an adaptive, SLO-aware weighted traffic drain controller to replace brittle step-based blue/green scripts used in hosted API regional rollouts. The controller will: (1) perform coordinated weighted shifts across regions with per-customer routing awareness, (2) integrate live token-level latency and error signals to pause or reverse shifts, (3) support graceful drain of connections with KV-cache and persistent-session awareness, and (4) expose runtime knobs for on-call and SRE (manual hold, instant failover, and throttled expansion). This ticket covers design, implementation, and e2e tests for the controller plus a safe rollout playbook for initial pilot regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1).
acceptance_criteria: Controller can perform a weighted traffic shift between two model variants in a single region with <2s orchestration lag
Automatic pause and rollback triggers when 5xx rate increases by >1.5x or p95 latency degrades >30% sustained for 2 minutes
Per-customer and per-route overrides respected (VIP customers can be excluded or pinned during rollouts)
Graceful drain retains active KV cache sessions and allows explicit session-transfer APIs for long-lived calls
Can run in a staged regional plan: pilot -> ramp -> global, with a single command to abort to last known-good state
design_notes: Prefer controller-as-a-service running in control plane with signed commands; data-plane agents receive signed plan and execute local shifts
Use exponential backoff for ramp steps when detecting transient errors; include jitter to avoid correlated oscillation
Leverage existing tracing hooks in Console to compute token-level regressions; canonical metric set: request_rate, 5xx_rate, p50/p95 latency, kv_cache_miss_rate
Integrate model-variant compatibility table (from model catalog) so controller only shifts between compatible runtime profiles to avoid kernel mismatch failures
Expose a dry-run mode that emits simulated traffic distribution changes and a validation report before applying
technical_decisions: Controller will compute weights centrally and push signed weight deltas to region agents (avoid per-request global coordination)
Rollback policy: hysteresis window of 3 minutes with majority-vote across regions for global rollbacks; local rollbacks allowed if single-region SLO breached
Draining: mark instances as DRAINING then wait for active KV sessions to finish or reach a configurable cutoff, then switch weight to 0
Observability: attach an ephemeral debug trace ID to rollout operations; Console will surface per-rollout timelines and correlated latency/error spikes
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: cascading rollback storms if multiple regions detect transient blips simultaneously. Mitigation: randomized stagger + global coordination token to serialize rollback decisions.
Risk: weight-flapping due to noisy metrics. Mitigation: require sustained signal for 2 minutes and use EWMA smoothing on metrics.
Risk: KV cache warmup penalty after quick failover. Mitigation: allow configurable warmup window and optional parallel warmup traffic to new variant before shifting critical VIP customers.
Risk: operator error with manual commands. Mitigation: RBAC for rollout actions and confirmation modal with impact estimates in Console
